int pe[N];
int inq[N];

{
	return e[x].c - e[x].f;

	queue<int> q;
	q.push(s);
	inq[s] = 1;
	while(!q.empty())
	{
		int k = q.front();
		q.pop();
		inq[k] = 0;
		for(auto x : g[k])
		{
			if(!rem(x)) continue;
			int c = e[x].cost;
			int y = e[x].y;
			if(d[y] > d[k] + c)

					q.push(y);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	{
		e[pe[cur]].f++;
		e[pe[cur] ^ 1].f--;
		cur = p[cur];
	}
	ans += d[t];

	g[x].push_back(e.size());
	e.push_back(edge(y, c, 0, cost));

	e.push_back(edge(x, 0, 0, -cost));

{
	int n, m, k, c, d;

	{
		int x;
		cin >> x;
		add_edge(s, x, 1, 0);
	}
	int tt = 101;
	for(int i = 0; i < tt; i++)
		add_edge(1 + i * n, t, k, i * c);
	for(int i = 0; i < m; i++)
	{
		int x, y;
		cin >> x >> y;
		for(int i = 0; i < tt - 1; i++)
			for(int j = 0; j < k; j++)
			{
				add_edge(x + i * n, y + i * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
				add_edge(y + i * n, x + i * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1));
